latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of keyapi-google-search — unified Google web and image search skill.

- Supports ranked Google web search with titles, snippets, URLs, and result count control (up to 100).
- Provides Google image search with country and language targeting, pagination (page, count), and filtering options.
- Cache-first workflow: persists API responses locally to minimize redundant calls.
- Simple command-line usage with schema introspection, example queries, and flexible parameterization.
- Practical analysis scenarios for content research, competitive analysis, and visual asset discovery.
